facts.text: Quad-v0 is registered with entry point gym_rotor.envs:QuadEnv and max_episode_steps 10000
The state vector is 18 numbers: position (3), velocity (3), the rotation matrix in column-major order (9) and body angular velocity (3)
The action space is Box(-1.0, 1.0, shape=(4,)): four normalized motor commands
The observation space bounds position at +-1 m, velocity at +-4 m/s, the nine rotation-matrix elements at +-1 and angular velocity at +-2*pi rad/s
The nominal quadrotor parameters are mass 2.15 kg, arm length 0.23 m, inertia diag(0.022, 0.022, 0.035) kg m2, torque-to-thrust coefficient 0.0135, thrust-to-weight coefficient 2.2 and gravity 9.81
The hover thrust of each motor is m*g/4, the minimum thrust is 0.5 N and the maximum is c_tw times the hover thrust
A normalized action is scaled linearly from [-1, 1] to [min_force, max_force] and clipped to that range
The simulation advances at 200 Hz, so one step is 0.005 s
The equations of motion are x_dot = v, v_dot = g*e3 - f*R*e3/m, R_vec_dot = (R*hat(W)) in column-major order and W_dot = J^-1(-hat(W)*J*W + M)
The default ODE integrator is solve_ivp with the DOP853 method

A reset draws yaw uniformly in [-pi, pi]; in 80 percent of training resets the initial position, velocity, attitude and angular-velocity bounds are 0.6 m, 2.0 m/s, 50 degrees and pi rad/s, and in the other 20 percent they are zero
The state limits are position 1.0 m, velocity 4.0 m/s, angular velocity 2*pi rad/s and Euler angle 85 degrees
The episode terminates when any position, velocity or angular-velocity component reaches its limit, or when |roll| or |pitch| reaches 85 degrees
The scalar reward is -Cx*||x-xd||^2 - Cv*||v-vd||^2 - Cb1*|e_b1| - CW*||W||^2 plus reward_alive
The default reward coefficients are Cx 6.0, CIx 0.1, Cv 0.4, Cb1 6.0, CIb1 0.1 and Cw12 (used as CW) 0.6
QuadEnv.step indexes the scalar returned by reward_wrapper and the boolean returned by done_wrapper, so it raises TypeError before returning under any framework value
QuadEnv.reset returns the observation array alone, not an (observation, info) tuple
The rotation matrix is stored in column-major order and state_decomposition reshapes it with order='F', re-orthonormalizing it when it is not in SO(3)

determinism.notes: cap.world.reset.v1 with a seed, or a seed set by cap.world.seed.v1, makes the fake repeat a trajectory for the same actions; the fake draws with Python's random.Random and upstream with numpy's global generator, so one seed gives different trajectories on the two

gaps: rigid-body equations of motion of a quadrotor with ideal motor forces: no contacts, aerodynamics, actuator lag, sensor or noise model, and the physical parameters are randomized only through the upstream's uniform domain randomization

the fake integrates with explicit Euler at the 200 Hz step while the upstream default is scipy.integrate.solve_ivp with DOP853 (quad.py:62, :263-266), and re-orthonormalizes the stored attitude every step while upstream re-orthonormalizes only inside state_decomposition (quad_utils.py:123-142): trajectories can differ
the fake draws initial states and domain-randomized parameters with Python's random.Random; upstream uses numpy's global generator, so a seed does not reproduce the upstream trajectory

the upstream step indexes a scalar reward and a boolean done (quad.py:153-168), so it raises TypeError; the fake implements the intended five-value API and returns the scalar reward of reward_wrapper, not the CMP/DMP/NMP normalization that the upstream step attempts
the modular wrappers (CoupledWrapper, DecoupledWrapper) are not served: this driver is the base Quad-v0 environment whose action is four motor thrusts
the registered 10000-step TimeLimit is applied directly by the fake; the gymnasium wrapper is not present when the fake object is served, and there is no rendering
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and clock lockstep, so only step calls advance simulated time by the 5 ms integration step
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes get_current_state but no set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
